execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clientGroups" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."clients" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "groupId" int4,
  "ice" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."companyInfo" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "businessLicense" text,
  "commercialRegister" text,
  "commonBusinessId" text,
  "companyName" text NOT NULL,
  "defaultTvaRate" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "logoPath" text,
  "phoneNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "socialSecurityNo" text,
  "taxIdNumber" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."creditPayments" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "creditId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "creditPayments_method_check_f7d63ca3" CHECK ("method" IN ('cash', 'cheque'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."credits" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "clientId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4,
  "supplierInvoiceId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "credits_one_party_c237646c" CHECK (num_nonnulls("clientId", "supplierId") = 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentCounters" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lastSeq" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documentCounters_type_check_06310384" CHECK ("type" IN ('invoice', 'draft', 'delivery_note', 'uninvoiced', 'credit_note'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documentLines" (
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "discountPercent" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "lineSubtotal" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "lineTotal" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric(14,3) NOT NULL,
  "tvaAmount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "tvaRate" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitCost" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (
  "clientId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discountTotal" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "documentDate" date DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "number" text NOT NULL,
  "relatedDocumentId" int4,
  "seq" int4 NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "tvaTotal" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_type_check_06310384" CHECK ("type" IN ('invoice', 'draft', 'delivery_note', 'uninvoiced', 'credit_note'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenses" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "expenseDate" date DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'info' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_963f008b" CHECK ("type" IN ('low_stock', 'info'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "bank" text,
  "chequeNumber" text,
  "clientId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4,
  "supplierInvoiceId" int4,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_method_check_f7d63ca3" CHECK ("method" IN ('cash', 'cheque')),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_one_party_407d43ed" CHECK (num_nonnulls("clientId", "supplierId") <= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "barcode" text NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imagePath" text,
  "minQtyAlert" numeric(14,3) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "packaging" text,
  "purchasePrice" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric(14,3) NOT NULL,
  "quotePrice" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "sellingPrice" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4,
  "unit" text DEFAULT 'unit' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "products_quantity_nonneg_6553cc0b" CHECK (quantity >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "products_unit_check_b8b650e6" CHECK ("unit" IN ('kg', 'm', 'unit'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "expire" timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
  "sess" json NOT NULL,
  "sid" character varying NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "session_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("sid")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stockMovements" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" int4,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" numeric(14,3) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "unitCost" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stockMovements_type_check_41e1afbb" CHECK ("type" IN ('purchase', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplierInvoices" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "invoiceDate" date DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "total" numeric(14,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."suppliers" (
  "activities" text,
  "address" text,
  "companyName" text NOT NULL,
  "contactName" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fax" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "phone1" text NOT NULL,
  "phone2" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'cashier' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_0ed15a98" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'manager', 'finance', 'stock', 'cashier'))
)
